title: Hanuman Ansh's Parvati song-fame Iranian actor Agni Agyari: I have a past life connection with India, dil se main Indian hoon!
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Iranian star Agni Agyari is relishing the spotlight on her following the unprecedented success of the music video of Parvati, a bhajan from the movie Hanuman Ansh voiced by Sadhu Tiwari, climbed to No. 1 on YouTube Music’s weekly songs chart in India and No. 2 globally. She says there is some divine connection between her and India that’s showering so much love on her.

Adding to this, Star-musician Agni Agyari and a still from the song Parvati from movie Hanuman Ansh (Photo: Instagram) Agni was not the part of the smash hit movie and featured in the musical video that had singer-writer-composer Sadhu Tiwari performing while she played musical instruments.

Meanwhile, “I can only say that this is bhagwan ka ashirwad and I’m a blessed child. I am not in the movie but just a part of the widely shared Parvati video song which I got as I could play musical instruments like hand pan and kahoon (clapbox). They wanted a musician more than an star and my musical training came handy. I even wore my own sari! And, it’s globally trending with people showing so much love for me. People are now noticing my previous work and dots are connecting which is a big thing for me,” she says thanking director Dr Vishal Chaturvedi and singer-composer Rishi Pathak for giving her the chance.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Agni Agyari (@agniagyari)

As per the latest buzz, “I don’t know what connection is it but I believe kuch to hai jo mujhe India se jodta hai…maybe past life connection? I was born and raised in Tehran, Iran in Zoroastrian faith, but I was always fascinated by Indian movies. One bhajan that I got hooked on as a child was Om Jai Jagdish Hare . I wrote that in Persian and used to sing in front of Saraswati Maa’s pix that was gifted by my mummy’s student. Dil se mein Indian hi hoon!” says Agni.
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Agni Agyari (@agniagyari)

On top of that, In India since the last four years, she has worked with commercials with actors Shah Rukh Khan , Kareena Kapoor Khan and Yami Gautam besides working in TV series Bade Acche Lagte Hain-3 and Showtime .

Agni says she strategically planned her path but what’s happening is divine. “For two years I did not do any project where I needed to speak as I wanted to learn to speak Hindi as I didn’t want to do foreign national roles. And, now results are showing I did Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s production Do Deewane Seher Mein earlier this year and the of late rolled out movie Love Lottery directed Arvind Pandey sir.”

title: Drishyam 3 box office collection day 3 (updated live): Ajay Devgn film continues rampage, crosses ₹150 crore to beat Awarapan 2, The RajaSaab lifetime
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Drishyam 3 ticket-window earnings day 3: Ajay Devgn’s Drishyam The Conclusion is continuing its rampage at the domestic ticket-window for the third day in a row. The crime thriller, which marks the culmination of the Drishyam saga, has crossed the ₹ 150 crore rupees mark and is poised to storm past the ₹ 200 crore rupees mark soon.

Adding to this, Drishyam 3 ticket-window earnings day 3: Jaideep Ahlawat plays Rajveer Singh Tomar, an IPS officer, in Drishyam The Conclusion. Drishyam 3 ticket-window update The advance bookings for Drishyam The Conclusion were enough indication that the movie was poised for a massive opening weekend. The movie registered the fourth-highest advance-booking collection for an opening day by a Hindi movie. The overall advance booking for the opening weekend exceeded ₹ 50 crore rupees even before rollout. Drishyam 3 sold 13 lakh tickets before it rolled out. All of this culminated in a historic opening weekend.

Meanwhile, On rollout day, Drishyam The Conclusion collected a massive ₹ 62 crore rupees net in India, the fourth-biggest opening by a Hindi movie ever. On Saturday, the movie dipped a bit, returning figures of ₹ 53.50 crore rupees. However, it was still enough to take the movie past ₹ 100 crore rupees. On Sunday, the movie saw its earnings accelerate. By 5 PM , Drishyam The Conclusion had crossed the ₹ 150 crore rupees mark, settling in at ₹ 154 crore rupees net.

Notably, On Sunday, Drishyam 3’s morning shows saw around 42% occupancy across India, with some tier-2 and tier-3 centres reporting even higher occupancy. This is already among the biggest opening weekends by a Hindi movie in history.

As per the latest buzz, Drishyam The Conclusion’s record-breaking opening weekend has allowed it to surpass the lifetime collections of several big films from recent times. It had already beaten Salman Khan ’s Sikandar ( ₹ 107 crore rupees) on Saturday. By Sunday afternoon, it had surpassed Prabhas’ The RajaSaab ( ₹ 138 crore rupees), Emraan Hashmi’s Awarapan 2 ( ₹ 150 crore rupees), and Ajay’s own movie, Shaitaan ( ₹ 144 crore rupees).

In further updates, Drishyam The Conclusion is on course to register one of the biggest opening weekends for a Hindi movie at the domestic market. The overall record - Dhurandhar 2’s massive ₹ 443 crore rupees start - is well beyond its reach, as are the marks set by Shah Rukh Khan’s Jawan ( ₹ 286 crore rupees) and Pathaan ( ₹ 280 crore rupees). But a strong day has helped it break into the top 10, potentially overtaking War ( ₹ 166 crore rupees) and Sultan ( ₹ 180 crore rupees). However, surpassing Animal ( ₹ 202 crore rupees) and Stree 2 ( ₹ 204 crore rupees) may just be out of its grasp.

On top of that, The third part of the franchise brings back Ajay Devgn ’s Vijay Salgaonkar, along with Tabu, Shriya Saran, Rajat Kapoor, Ishita Dutta, Mrunal Jadhav, and Kamlesh Sawant. The new entrants in the cast are Jaideep Ahlawat and Prakash Raj. Written and directed by Abhishek Pathak, the movie rolled out in theatres on October 2.

Abhimanyu Mathur is Deputy Editor, Entertainment at Hindustan Times. With almost 15 years of experience in writing about everything from films and TV shows to cricket matches and elections, he inhales and exhales pop culture and news. Currently, he watches movies and TV shows and talks to celebrities for a living, while occasionally writing about them as well. A journalism graduate of Delhi College of Arts and Commerce, Delhi University, Abhimanyu began his career with Hindustan Times at the age of 20, swapping classrooms for newsrooms at an early age. He began his journey in the early days of digital journalism, later switching to the madness of print journalism. Work has led him to far off places like Japan and Jordan, as well as to the interiors of Haryana and the Indo-Pak border. He dabbled in city reporting in places like Meerut, Gurgaon, and Delhi, covered the Olympics and Cricket World Cups, before finding his calling in entertainment and lifestyle during the pandemic. A Rotten Tomatoes Certified Movie Critic, he is equally at home covering stories on ground as he is interviewing celebrities and studios, and sometimes prefers to shepherd teams in delivering traffic through the day. Even as his role has evolved from reporter to supervisor over the years, his first love remains writing (and of late, talking on camera). title: Soha Ali Khan on World animal day: The first connection I had with an animal was with a little mouse that lived in my bedroom
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

On World animal day, in a chat with us Soha Ali Khan says she has always had an instinctive connection with animals. She says, "As a child I grew up spending a lot of time in Bhopal and Pataudi surrounded by farm animals . At our home in Delhi we were surrounded by a lot of guests like lizards and mice. The first connection I had with an animal was with a little mouse that lived in my bedroom. City children today would be freaked out but I was comfortable sharing my room with a little mouse." She recalls spending a lot of time in the wild in jungles with her family. "I understood animals weren't there to play with, they just existed and we didn't need to interact excessively with them. I was curious but respected that there could be distance between us and animals," says Soha.

Adding to this, Soha with Oreo The star recalls her father (Tiger Pataudi) telling her it's important for every child to grow up with a pet. "That's why we always had dogs growing up. It teaches you to deal with grief because you will inevitably outlive your pet and have to deal with that grief as a child . That is an important life lesson. When Masti (Kunal Kemmu's dog) passed away it was difficult for Kunal and me but also for Inaaya, it was the first time she had encountered loss and the finality of death." Kunal went on to get a tattoo of Masti. She says, "I knew Kunal was going to get Masti tattooed on his body and it was touching because she was his baby and a tattoo is permanent. It's beautiful to carry a memory of an animal on your body, he had an incredibly deep bond with Masti, so it was only right she should be with him forever."

Meanwhile, Currently pet parent to her dog Oreo Soha says animals pick up on tone, body language, energy or any change in routine. She says, "If Kunal and I start to have an argument or opposing point of view, Oreo picks up on that and starts barking. He jumps on us and tries to get us to bring down our tone. Oreo is empathetic, he comes to whoever is feeling low and licks your ear or put his head on you. He's like a therapy dog."

Notably, She says yhe animal She is fascinated by is the elephant. "They are massive but also intelligent. I'm intrigued by how they form bonds, I would love to observe them in their natural environment without being intrusive. I've seen mothers protecting their babies as well as how they flap their ears when angry, during a trip to South Africa, it's terrifying."

As per the latest buzz, Speaking about how Inaaya looks after Oreo she says, “She makes sure she's not feeding him too many treats and he's not having the food we have. When her friends come home she instructs them on how to look after him. She does not getting carried away and remembers he's not a soft toy and that there is a certain way you have to carry him, their spine is different unlike ours.”

title: From Madgaon Express to Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara: 5 best buddy comedies to watch on OTT with your friends
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:

There is something special about movies that put friendship at the centre of the story. From chaotic road trips and disastrous holidays to college memories and friendships that survive the toughest phases of life, buddy comedies are the perfect fix for the end of a bad day.

Adding to this, Madgaon Express and Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara explore old friendship and the chaos that comes with it. If you’re looking for a fun movie to watch with your friends or simply want to relive some old memories, here are five buddy comedies you can watch on OTT.

Meanwhile, Not many Bollywood films have captured the emotional complexity and chaos of male friendship quite like Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara . The 2011 movie follows three childhood friends -- Arjun ( Hrithik Roshan ), Kabir (Abhay Deol) and Imran (Farhan Akhtar) -- who head to Europe for a bachelor trip that becomes a journey of self-discovery and, in many ways, a rejuvenation of their school friendship. From skydiving and deep-sea diving to the iconic La Tomatina sequence, the movie sees the three friends navigate the roads of Europe while also learning a little more about each other -- and themselves.

Notably, Packed with confrontation, hilarious banter, adventure and moments of introspection, the movie explores how friendships survive for years when people learn to accept, forgive and evolve with each other. Directed by Zoya Akhtar, you can watch this movie on Netflix.

As per the latest buzz, While in ZNMD, the three good-looking leads travel across Europe, Kunal Kemmu’s directorial debut Madgaon Express hits closer to home. It follows three friends, played by Divyenndu, Pratik Gandhi and Avinash Tiwary, who have been planning a trip to Goa since school, only to finally fulfil their wish after becoming full-grown adults.

In further updates, However, this isn’t a journey of self-discovery and contemplation. Their long-awaited holiday takes a hilariously wrong turn when they get entangled with a local drug mafia. What starts as a much-awaited getaway soon lands them in a series of scary yet ridiculously funny situations involving gangsters, mistaken identities and complete chaos. A full-blown comedy of errors, Madgaon Express is one of the best buddy comedies of recent times. You can watch it on Amazon Prime Video and laugh till your stomach hurts.

On top of that, Nitesh Tiwari might be busy with his highly anticipated movie Ramayana now, but in 2019, he gave us one of the most memorable buddy comedies of recent times — Chhichhore. The movie takes viewers back to the carefree days of college life while exploring the friendships that stay with us long after graduation. It stars Sushant Singh Rajput, Varun Sharma, Shraddha Kapoor, Tahir Raj Bhasin and others.

body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Adding to this, Pawar urges Maharashtra govt to hold talks with protesting MPSC aspirants In conversation with reporters, Pawar noted unease among students in Pune and Mumbai and emphasised that meaningful communication between state leadership and student bodies is essential to end the deadlock.

title: Drishyam 3 worldwide box office collection: Ajay Devgn film races to ₹177 crore; beats part 1's lifetime haul in just 2 days
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Drishyam 3 worldwide ticket-window earnings day 2: After a record-breaking start on Friday, Ajay Devgn ’s Drishyam: The Conclusion slowed down a bit on Saturday, but still had enough momentum to cross the ₹ 150 crore rupees mark in just two days. The movie has now entered the top 10 highest-grossing Hindi films of the year and is set to climb the list very quickly.

Adding to this, Drishyam 3 worldwide ticket-window earnings day 2: Ajay Devgn stars in this thriller. Drishyam 3 ticket-window update The advance bookings for Drishyam The Conclusion were proof of how well it was slated to perform. The movie registered the fourth-highest advance-booking collection for an opening day by a Hindi movie. The overall advance booking for the movie by rollout day exceeded ₹ 50 crore rupees. This converted into a strong opening day, helping the movie amass ₹ 93 crore rupees worldwide on Friday.

Meanwhile, The trend of solid collections continued on Saturday as well. The Abhishek Pathak directorial collected ₹ 53.50 crore rupees net on Saturday in addition to the ₹ 62 crore rupees it collected on Friday. This takes the Drishyam The Conclusion’s domestic earnings to ₹ 115.50 crore rupees net ( ₹ 138.60 crore rupees gross) after two days. The movie is on course for one of the biggest opening weekends for a Hindi movie, rivalling Stree 2 and Animal.

Notably, Overseas, Drishyam 3 did not have the same kind of craze and fervour, but it still performed better than most of Ajay Devgn's films. According to trade sources, Drishyam The Conclusion showed an improvement overseas on Saturday. So far, it has collected a neat $4 million in international territories. This takes its worldwide gross to ₹ 177 crore rupees.

As per the latest buzz, Drishyam 3’s mind-blowing start has put many pan-India films in the shade. It has also surpassed the lifetime collections of many recent big-budget films, including Salman Khan’s Sikandar, which collected ₹ 176 crore rupees last year. But most impressive has been Drishyam The Conclusion’s performance relative to the first two parts. On Saturday morning, the movie surpassed the lifetime collection of Drishyam. The 2015 movie collected ₹ 107 crore rupees at the ticket-window.

In further updates, The third part of the franchise brings back Ajay Devgn’s Vijay Salgaonkar, along with Tabu, Shriya Saran, Rajat Kapoor, Ishita Dutta, Mrunal Jadhav, and Kamlesh Sawant. Saurabh Shukla also reprises his role from part 2 in a cameo. The new entrants in the cast are Jaideep Ahlawat and Prakash Raj. Written and directed by Abhishek Pathak, the movie rolled out in theatres on October 2, a date quite significant for the franchise.

On top of that, Abhimanyu Mathur is Deputy Editor, Entertainment at Hindustan Times. With almost 15 years of experience in writing about everything from films and TV shows to cricket matches and elections, he inhales and exhales pop culture and news. Currently, he watches movies and TV shows and talks to celebrities for a living, while occasionally writing about them as well. A journalism graduate of Delhi College of Arts and Commerce, Delhi University, Abhimanyu began his career with Hindustan Times at the age of 20, swapping classrooms for newsrooms at an early age. He began his journey in the early days of digital journalism, later switching to the madness of print journalism. Work has led him to far off places like Japan and Jordan, as well as to the interiors of Haryana and the Indo-Pak border. He dabbled in city reporting in places like Meerut, Gurgaon, and Delhi, covered the Olympics and Cricket World Cups, before finding his calling in entertainment and lifestyle during the pandemic. A Rotten Tomatoes Certified Movie Critic, he is equally at home covering stories on ground as he is interviewing celebrities and studios, and sometimes prefers to shepherd teams in delivering traffic through the day. Social media creator Nazma Shaikh has broken her silence on the row after videos surfaced online alleging that he was asked to leave during the prayer meet of star Mushtaq Khan.

Adding to this, Rajpal Yadav at Mushtaq Khan's prayer meet. Nazma Shaikh addresses the incident Addressing the widely shared videos and claims circulating online, Nazma shared her anger was directed at people taking pictures during the funeral and not at Rajpal Yadav.

Meanwhile, On Friday, Nazma shared a video on her social media account, explaining what happened during the prayer meet and burial. She shared several reports had created “misconceptions” about the incident and urged people to understand the complete context before drawing conclusions.

Notably, In her video, she shared, “The reality is that Rajpal bhaiya was very close to Mushtaq Khan. He considered him like an elder brother, and they shared a very close bond. Two hours before Mushtaq Khan’s death, Rajpal Bhaiya was with him. He was also present on the day Mushtaq Khan was taken to the graveyard. He was present at the prayer meet as well….I’m sharing these facts so that people can understand the reality and not be misled by misconceptions.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Nazma Shaikh ( Fame Media ) (@nazma9846)

In further updates, The video appeared to show Nazma speaking with Rajpal Yadav and asking him to leave the premises. But in the new video, Nazma explained that her reaction was towards people who were taking pictures during the funeral without considering the situation.

On top of that, She shared, “My anger was directed towards those people who were there only to click pictures, without understanding the kind of atmosphere they were in. I want to make it very clear that my anger was not directed at Rajpal Bhaiya. It was directed at those who were taking pictures at a time and place where people were there to mourn and pay their respects.”
“I urge my friends in the media not to run misleading narratives. Please understand the complete context and publish the whole truth,” she added.

title: 'Anger in the streets': Tens of thousands protest in Spain over housing crisis
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
About 50 marches took place on Saturday in cities including Madrid, Valencia and Barcelona.
Adding to this, "There is a lot of anger in the streets," a spokesperson for the Valencia Tenants' Union shared. Clashes took have taken place between some protesters and police in the city.

Meanwhile, The measures put forward by Pedro Sánchez's leftist coalition government on Friday followed public outcry over the eviction of an 87-year-old woman from her home last month after she was unable to afford a sharp rent increase.

Notably, Her eviction triggered nationwide protests across Spain with protesters demanding lower rents, an end to evictions, and a ban on investment funds - or "vulture funds" as the government has termed them - buying property.
As per the latest buzz, Sanchez's defeat in Congress on Friday heightens speculation that he might call an early general election, which was not due until next summer.
In further updates, His coalition government, made up of his ruling Socialist party and junior partner the Sumar alliance, does not command a majority in parliament.

On top of that, Photographs showed protesters in the east coast city of Valencia clashing with police officers on Saturday near arts centre Palau de les Arts Reina Sofía, which was hosting a real estate summit.

Several protesters removed barriers and threw objects at officers, who responded with rubber bullets, Spanish media reported. Public broadcaster RTVE shared nine police officers were injured and five people were arrested.

title: Dipke, Das, CJP leaders and 400+ supporters booked after Shivaji Park protest in Mumbai
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Shivaji Park police have registered a case against Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Saurabh Das, Pranav Ahire, Ashutosh Ranka, Ajinkya Shinde, Afreen Nawaz, Saumya Korde, Ankit Bharadwaj, Vijay Malangi and Yogesh Ingle, along with more than 400 unidentified supporters, for allegedly holding an unlawful assembly and raising slogans during the party’s protest at Shivaji Park on Friday.

Adding to this, Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke, singer and songwriter Vishal Dadlani and others during a protest by CJP against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar, demanding his resignation, at Shivaji Park, in Mumbai (PTI) According to the police, around 400-500 protesters gathered near Gate No. 6 of the Shivaji Park grounds, in front of the Meenatai Thackeray Memorial, from around 2pm to 7pm.

Meanwhile, The police alleged that the gathering obstructed traffic and that loudspeakers were used without the required permission. The case has been registered under Sections 189 (unlawful assembly) and 223 (disobedience to a public servant’s lawful order) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), besides Sections 37 and 135 of the Maharashtra Police Act.

Notably, The case follows the CJP’s decision to proceed with its ‘Jail Bharo Andolan��� at Shivaji Park despite the Mumbai Police denying permission for the gathering. The police had advised the organisers to seek an alternative venue, citing restrictions on the use of the historic ground under a 2013 Bombay High Court order and a subsequent Maharashtra government order. The police also shared the organisers had not submitted the requisite BMC permission for using the ground.

As per the latest buzz, In its communication to CJP, the police cited Shivaji Park’s residential surroundings and silence-zone status, warning that the protest could lead to noise pollution and traffic congestion and potentially affect access to hospitals in the vicinity. The organisers, however, went ahead with the agitation after CJP founder Dipke opened up that the denial of permission would lead to a ‘Jail Bharo Andolan’. Dipke had also posted on X that the Mumbai Police had denied permission for the October 2 protest, calling the decision an attempt to suppress citizens’ voices.

In further updates, The protest was organised to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar amid allegations concerning the Election Commission’s handling of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR ) of electoral rolls. CJP leaders have also demanded a criminal case against Kumar and a rollback of the SIR exercise. The Election Commission has defended the revision process.

On top of that, The gathering drew thousands of people, predominantly young protesters, as well as public figures including actors Shabana Azmi and Naseeruddin Shah, singer Vishal Dadlani and filmmaker Vishal Bhardwaj. Tushar Gandhi, Mahatma Gandhi’s great-grandson, was also present. The police deployed around 300 personnel and shared the situation remained peaceful, with roads leading to Shivaji Park blocked during the protest and cleared afterwards.

Addressing the gathering, Dipke shared the protest was the beginning of a wider agitation and warned of a prolonged campaign if Kumar did not resign. He shared the movement would continue for three months and referred to a planned “Jantar Mantar 2.0”.

title: Disha Salian death case: Advocate submits new piece of evidence to CBI, seeks custodial interrogation of accused: ‘We intend to file a fresh petition’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Advocate Nilesh Ojha, in connection with the death case of Disha Salian , on Saturday, shared that points raised by him earlier were being substantiated as more evidence emerged. In a new update from news agency ANI, Ojha claimed that a report submitted to the Home Ministry regarding the reinstatement of former police officer Sachin Vaze had raised fresh questions in the case.

Adding to this, Disha Salian, former star manager, has made headlines due to her father accusing Shiv Sena (UBT)'s Aaditya Thackeray in the case of her death (@Rishabhsingh4747/Instagram) What Advocate Ojha shared Advocate Ojha, representing Satish Salian in the case, shared, "Regarding this case, all the points we raised are being substantiated as more evidence comes to light. From our allegations of a false cover-up and the state of Disha's body to the High Court order, the SIT report, and the records currently with the CBI, everything we claimed is being proven true."

Meanwhile, Ojha told ANI that he had obtained a new piece of evidence in the form of a report submitted to the Home Ministry. "We have now obtained a new piece of evidence: a report submitted to the Home Ministry. It clearly states that on June 5, 2020, Sachin Vaze was urgently reinstated into service and assigned to the Crime Intelligence Unit (CIU)," he shared.

Notably, He further alleged that Vaze's appointment to the CIU violated the applicable regulations. Ojha further shared, "The rules required an officer of the rank of Police Inspector (PI) for the CIU, but Sachin Vaze did not meet this criterion; he was of a lower rank, yet he was appointed there in violation of the regulations."

As per the latest buzz, "This evidence suggests that Vaze was urgently reinstated to execute a conspiracy that included the murder of Disha and its subsequent cover-up, as well as to facilitate extortion, the drug trade, and other illicit activities," he shared. Ojha shared that all the details had been submitted to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) on Saturday.

In further updates, "We have submitted all these details to the CBI today. We have outlined three other important demands to the CBI in today's letter, as we intend to file a fresh petition in the High Court seeking immediate custodial interrogation of the accused and requesting that the investigation proceed under High Court supervision,” he added.

On top of that, Disha, who briefly worked with star Sushant Singh Rajput, died after falling from the 12th floor of a building in Malad at about 2:25 am on June 9, 2020. The Malwani police registered an accidental death report in connection with the incident and concluded that it was a suicide and that there was no evidence suggesting any foul play in it. A Special Investigation Team set up by the state government in December 2023 also found no foul play in Disha's death.

title: Ajay Devgn calls Captain Smit Machchhar a hero in every sense of the word, wishes him a speedy recovery
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Ajay Devgn on Saturday lauded flydubai pilot Captain Smit Machchhar for his heroics during the flight FZ1073 incident. He helped save the lives of 174 people on board a Flydubai flight after he was attacked and stabbed by his co-pilot mid-air.

Adding to this, Ajay Devgn salutes the bravery of Captain Smit Machchhar. What Ajay Devgn wrote Taking to X, Ajay Devgn wrote, “There are heroes, and then there are those who show us what true courage looks like. Captain Smit Machchhar, you are a hero in every sense of the word. Wishing you strength and a speedy recovery.”

Meanwhile, Earlier, Shah Rukh Khan has applauded his bravery on X. He wrote, “Captain Smit Machchhar, you stood strong when it mattered the most!! It’s not easy to stare adversity in the face and put one’s safety on the line… but you did just that to protect those onboard and showed us what being a Captain entails. A true display of courage and duty. Wishing you a speedy recovery, the country is proud of you…”

Notably, Salman Khan had also lauded Smit's bravery. On Friday night, Salman shared a heartfelt note on X. He wrote, “Kamaal kar diya pilot ji, hum sab aap ko salute karte hain (You’ve done a fantastic job, Pilot-ji; we all salute you) Will be a pleasure to fly with u.. Well done bro.. Capt #SmitMachchhar.”

As per the latest buzz, Karan Johar of late shared a photo of the captain and wrote, “It takes another grain of courage to be fighting for your own life but in that split second, put the lives of all others before yours. And that's what captain Smit Machchhar did in the face of the toughest times. And for that, the entire country & humankind is behind you! Thank you for your selfless, courageous and brave heart, you are an inspiration for the generations to come.”

In further updates, Vicky Kaushal called the captain a “braveheart”, while Ranveer Singh described him as “courageous”. Other celebrities, including Paresh Rawal, R Madhavan, Vijay Deverakonda and Ravi Kishan, have also lauded the captain and wished him a speedy recovery.

On top of that, Captain Smit Machchhar was the pilot of Flydubai flight FZ1073, a Boeing 737 MAX 8 travelling from Dubai to Tel Aviv with 174 people on board, including 27 children. On September 30, while the aircraft was flying over Saudi Arabia, Machchhar was attacked and stabbed by his co-pilot inside the cockpit.

Despite being seriously injured, Machchhar managed to open the cockpit door. This allowed passengers and crew members to intervene and overpower the attacker. Two other pilots who were travelling on the flight then helped take control of the aircraft, which was diverted and safely landed at Tabuk airport in Saudi Arabia.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Siddharth P Malhotra reveals Ikka sequel and Shaque Season 2 are in the works; also shares happiness at the response to Parineeti Chopra starrer show: “Haven’t got so many calls for a series before”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Malhotra also spoke on his successful and long association with Netflix.

Adding to this, In an exclusive chat with Bollywood Hungama , Malhotra opened up that both the projects will have a second part. “ Ikka has broken records. There is Ikka 2 being worked on. Shaque has now broken records and Shaque Season 2 is being done. It has been a great year. Shaque Season 2 won’t continue the same story. It will be a new story. But a season 2 is in the works. We are writing it,” he shared.

Meanwhile, Malhotra also shared that director Rensil D’Silva had earlier envisioned Shaque as a movie when he came up with the idea years ago. “It was a story Rensil had cracked about 8-9 years ago,” he shared. “Initially, it was a feature movie. Then we worked on it and we shared that let’s see if we can make it into series. After writing it as a series, we realized that it has legs and potential. Then I sold it to Netflix. They liked the idea.”

Notably, Malhotra is happy with the response the show has generated in little over a week. “We have been getting a lot of feedback. It’s done really well. Even after one week, it’s at number one. In my whole career, I haven’t got so many calls for a series. Even people from South Bombay are calling and saying that they binged and enjoyed it. It’s a good feeling. Netflix is very happy. It’s done very well for them. It’s in the top 10 in 20-30 countries. When you go into a party or function, people are willingly saying that they found it very good. They will say it saamne se only when they actually liked it. If they didn’t, they would say that they haven’t watched it yet,” he shared.

As per the latest buzz, Shaque is a whodunit where the identity of the culprit is revealed at the end. In today’s times of social media, there is every chance of someone or the other revealing the climax. Malhotra shared that one can’t control that. “Social media is good and bad. If somebody wants to reveal the climax, you can’t stop that person. As far as people are talking and commenting about the show, we are very happy. Now, even after revealing the climax, if people are still watching the show, it’s the writing team’s victory,” he shared.

In further updates, During the trailer launch of Shaque, lead star Parineeti Chopra shared that she came to know after starting the shoot that she is pregnant. Hence, the makers ensured that she stayed at the same place where they were shooting, so that she doesn’t have to travel. Malhotra shared that this wasn’t challenging for them. “It is the responsibility between Sapna (Malhotra) and me to take care of her. She could have shared that she is pregnant and she won’t be able to shoot. But she is continued the shoot. So, we should take care of her, respect her and do the best we can,” he shared.

On top of that, As a director, Siddharth P Malhotra has made films on varied subjects like We Are Family (2010), Hichki (2018), Tribhanga (2021), Maharaj (2024) and Ikka (2026). When asked whether it has always been a conscious decision for him not to repeat genres, he shared, “It’s not a conscious effort to not repeat a genre. It’s actually an effort to try and find a story I can resonate to. Actually, for me the genre is the same as they are all (stories of) human relationships. The worlds might be different but the stories are of human relations and complex situations.”

Malhotra has had a successful and long collaboration with Netflix with a series of projects like Tribhanga , Maharaj , Ikka and now Shaque. “I have known Monika (Shergill, Vice President, Content) from the time I did Sanjivani (TV show) and before that. Their team is very co-operative and collaborative. All the success of any show or movie of Netflix is a collaborative effort. Their names don’t appear but they put in a lot of hard work. No single person can take credit of a success. It’s always a team work. Netflix has been a great collaborator and we are collaborating a lot now,” he shared.

title: ‘Hindi version is 100 times better’: Malayalam viewers hail Ajay Devgn’s Drishyam 3, compare it with Mohanlal’s film
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ajay Devgn -starrer Drishyam 3 has broken box-office records since opening in theatres on Friday. As the movie continues its strong run at the ticket-window, it isn't just Hindi-speaking audiences who are praising it. The Malayalam audience is also raving about the Ajay Devgn-starrer, with some even calling it better than Mohanlal's Malayalam version.

Adding to this, Malayalam viewers have called Ajay Devgn’s Drishyam 3 better than Mohanlal's movie. 'I had to clap after watching Ajay's Drishyam 3, the writing is brilliant' Of late, a Malayalam content creator posted a video praising Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3. The content creator admitted that Malayalam audiences have traditionally not been very fond of the Hindi version of the Drishyam franchise but Drishyam 3's writing and the way the makers concluded the franchise had them in awe.

Meanwhile, Praising Drishyam 3, the content creator shared in Malayalam, "Those Hindi guys gave such a good conclusion to Drishyam. Just think about it, I hadn’t watched the first and the second part of the Hindi version. We used to look down on it like - 'Whatever who has the time to watch Hindi films.' I had that contempt, but in the end, I had to clap after watching part three of Drishyam in Hindi. Unbelievable. Jeethu Joseph (director of original Malayalam version of Drishyam), doesn’t even have 1% of the writing credit for this movie, because they themselves wrote and set the whole thing up. They wrote it so brilliantly."

Notably, He added, “It’s a pure Hindi movie template, occasional jokes, and camera style that felt like a serial quality, but still there are high moments. There are thrill elements, things that the Drishyam characters intend to do are all present in this movie, that is why I am saying I am happy. I’m not saying everyone will watch this and be mind blown, but this makes sense. It’s not some crazy, mind-bending twist and turn, but they ended it really well as a proper continuation of part two.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by D.R (@blindmustwatch)

In further updates, The comments on the video also echoed the content creator's thoughts. One comment called the Hindi version of Drishyam 3 better than Mohanlal's Malayalam movie. The comment read, "I feel D3 Malayalam is like a soap opera... Hindi is 100 times better than this." One more comment read, "Malayalam drishym 3 was utter flop." Another supported the sentiment and shared, "Malayalam drishyam 3 felt like it was made more for business than for audience satisfaction." Another user joked, "Why don’t we remake the Hindi third part back to Malayalam."

On top of that, For the unversed, Drishyam: The Conclusion has an original story and ending, unlike the first two Hindi films, which were direct remakes of Mohanlal’s Malayalam Drishyam films. Director Abhishek Pathak has previously spoken about taking an entirely different route for the third instalment. Ajay Devgn has also opened up that he sought Mohanlal’s approval for Drishyam 3, as the team chose an independent direction with a brand-new script rather than directly remaking the Malayalam version.

The Ajay Devgn-starrer opened strongly at the ticket-window, collecting ₹ 66.75 crore rupees net in India on Day 1, according to Sacnilk. Its worldwide gross stood at an estimated ₹ 95.10 crore rupees on the opening day. The movie's Day 1 collection marked the biggest opening of Ajay Devgn's career.

Notably, In the letter issued to CJP, police cited a 2013 Bombay high court order restricting the use of Shivaji Park for purposes other than sports. Police also shared the organisers had not submitted the required BMC permission for using the ground. Citing the area’s residential and silence-zone status, police shared the proposed protest could cause noise pollution and severe traffic congestion, potentially affecting access to several hospitals in the area.

As per the latest buzz, The applicant was advised to look for alternate venues in Mumbai for the protest and ask for permission, which will be considered appropriately. However, the movement’s founder, Abhijeet Dipke had threatened a Jail Bharo Andolan on the occasion of Gandhi Jayanti, shared the officer.

In further updates, Officer shared Dipke was aware that permission had been denied. He himself wrote in a post on X, “Mumbai Police has denied permission for our protest on October 2. Such tactics to suppress citizens’ voices are unacceptable.”

On top of that, The CJP organised protests demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar following allegations of irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise and reports indicating that he had either ignored the opposition of the two election commissioners to certain commission decisions regarding the SIR or kept them in the dark.

title: Drishyam 3 box office collection day 2: Ajay Devgn film scores bumper Saturday as it crosses ₹115 crore, beats Sikandar lifetime
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Drishyam 3 ticket-window earnings day 2: Ajay Devgn in a still from the movie. Drishyam 3 ticket-window report On Friday, Drishyam 3 delivered a record opening for Ajay Devgn. The advance bookings for Drishyam The Conclusion opened on September 27, and the movie went on to collect ₹ 27 crore rupees before its rollout. By the end of the day, the movie went on to collect ₹ 66.75 crore rupees net across India. This is the third biggest opening by a Hindi movie ever and the biggest in Ajay Devgn’s career.

Adding to this, As per the latest update on Sacnilk, Drishyam 3 looks rock solid on its second day too. By 10 PM, the movie has managed to collect ₹ 53.50 crore rupees from a total of 11,212 shows. This brings the total collection to ₹ 115.50 crore rupees so far. Drishyam The Conclusion has now crossed the ₹ 100 crore rupees mark in two days, crossing the lifetime haul of Salman Khan's Sikandar ( ₹ 104 crore rupees).

Meanwhile, The movie has the second-biggest opening by a Hindi movie this year, behind only Dhurandhar The Revenge. It also has the third-biggest opening in Bollywood history, behind only Dhurandhar 2 and Jawan. It surpassed Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar ( ₹ 30 crore rupees) Shah Rukh Khan's Pathaan ( ₹ 57 crore rupees), and Ranbir Kapoor's Animal ( ₹ 63 crore rupees) to reach the milestone.

title: Avneet Kaur meets Tom Cruise, gushes about her favourite scene from Digger: ‘It takes a tremendous amount of skill’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Avneet Kaur attended the world premiere of Tom Cruise starrer Digger in London on September 23. The star has now shared a special interaction with the Hollywood superstar on her Instagram account.

Adding to this, Avneet Kaur met Tom Cruise to talk about Digger. Avneet meets Tom Cruise Tom hugged Avneet as the two met and then sat down facing each other to talk about Digger. Tom shared, “To get this movie made, it takes a tremendous amount of skill, ability and imagination. I have never read a character like this. We just keep learning, keep creating.” Avneet gushes that she has never seen him play such a character before. She asked him if he had a favourite scene from the movie.

Meanwhile, Tom smiled and shared, “Every day on set with Alejandro and the crew- it was such an outrageous character. We are looking at that monologue that I had, that was a 10 minute-monologue in one shot. It was just all one take.” Avneet shared that she was shocked and surprised to see the scene, and felt that the star must have really connected to the character to have brought that part out in the movie.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Avneet Kaur (@avneetkaur_13)

As per the latest buzz, Tom replied, “It is a rhythm. As an star one knows the beats to play. Alejandro's staging is perfect and it is a dance… I only did the scene a couple of times but it is all one take. I just showed up and did it. To be able to have that opportunity to play that, to show that transition, to show how you discover characters… the voice for Digger where it is something that is going to service the story. The comedic timing, I was also wearing a fat suit which was quite heavy… so yeah it is a dance, it is a rhythm, that was so much fun to play.”

In further updates, The HT review of the movie lauded Tom Cruise's performance and noted, “Digger’s story is staged like a play with long uncut shots, choreographed movements across the frame, and elaborate sets. Why Iñárritu chooses to tell the story this way is revealed in the movie. But it adds to not just the movie’s aesthetic but also the bizareness of it all. Digger always feels like a fever dream, but one that has the potential to hurt you in real life as well. It helps that the performances are top notch. Tom Cruise delivers one of his best in years, bringing to the fore the disdain, arrogance, and sheer apathy of a billionaire who is only concerned with money. His 10-minute monologue is a masterclass in staging, framing, and choreography where the star and the director collaborate to give a memorable sequence.”

title: Shabana Azmi backs CJP’s Mumbai protest; says, “We don’t have to tolerate anything wrong”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In conversation with reporters before taking the stage, Shabana highlighted the importance of voting rights and shared that any attempt to take away that right should be met through democratic means. She shared, “Voting is our right. If anyone tries to take away our right to vote, we will do what is necessary through democratic means.”

Adding to this, Addressing the gathering later, the star spoke about the importance of citizens raising their voices when their names are removed from electoral rolls. She shared, “A very, very warm greeting to all of you. Since I am from Mumbai, seeing all of you present here in such large numbers brings me immense happiness.”

Meanwhile, “Our vote is our right, it is our voice, we have been hearing this since childhood. But when our right is snatched away from us, when our names are removed from the electoral rolls, what will we do? We will protest. This is our right. Today, look around and see how far your eyes can reach, this is the victory of democracy. Because we have recognised our own strength, and we have realised that we do not have to tolerate anything wrong, because this is our country, our Constitution has given us this right. So, many congratulations to all of you,” she added.

Notably, The CJP has been opposing the SIR exercise and has been calling for Gyanesh Kumar to step down as Chief Election Commissioner. The organisation held the Mumbai gathering despite Mumbai Police denying permission for the protest. Heavy police deployment and barricades were put in place around Shivaji Park as a large crowd gathered at the venue. Reports on the size of the gathering varied, with police estimates later putting the number in the thousands.

As per the latest buzz, Naseeruddin Shah was also present at the protest and met CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke. A video shared by Dipke showed the two embracing. During their interaction, Shah told him, “I want to thank you,” while Dipke responded that he was a huge fan of the veteran star. Shah then shared, “I knew you were here. I am a huge fan of yours. Whatever you are doing, please continue doing that.”

In further updates, Vishal Dadlani and Vishal Bhardwaj were among the other movie personalities seen at the gathering. Star Prakash Raj also extended his support through a video message, speaking about democracy, citizenship and the ongoing SIR row.

On top of that, Meanwhile, Shabana’s husband and lyricist Javed Akhtar reacted to criticism over the protest and concerns about noise pollution at Shivaji Park. In a post on X, he questioned whether similar objections would be raised when political parties hold rallies at the same venue.
The CJP has maintained that its agitation is independent and has shared it will not join the Opposition’s separate October 6 protest against the Election Commission.

title: Arbaaz Khan walks away when asked about Salman Khan at Mumbai event: ‘Was the question related to event?'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Arbaaz Khan of late attended an event in Mumbai on Friday, October 2. The star interacted with the media at The Westin Mumbai Powai Lake during a jewellery brand event. However, his interaction with the paparazzi and reporters has caught attention online after he walked away when asked a question about his brother and Bollywood superstar Salman Khan .

Adding to this, Arbaaz Khan avoids question on Salman Khan. Arbaaz Khan avoids question on Salman Khan At the event, Arbaaz was posing for photographs and answering questions from the media. Amid this, a media person seem to be asking him about Salman’s recent comments on Bigg Boss 20, where the star criticised paparazzi for clicking inappropriate photographs of celebrities.
Meanwhile, Arbaaz, however, did not let the reporter finish the question and walked away. He quickly shared, “Excuse me... Thank you, thank you,” before leaving.

Notably, He later made his displeasure clear, suggesting that he dismissed the question because it was unrelated to the event. Arbaaz turned back and asked the media, “Jewellery se related tha? Aaj ke event se related tha woh sawal (Was it related to jewellery? Was that question related to today’s event)?”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Namaste Bollywood (@namastebollywood.in)

In further updates, In a recent episode of Bigg Boss, Salman called out photographers for clicking celebrities from inappropriate angles. He shared, “And then the one shot they take from behind, which none of the heroines like? There must be a few who say it’s okay, I don’t mind it. But what about those who don’t like it? I of late saw Saiee Manjrekar was so awkward with that, Neha Dhupia fought against it. My own niece, she was walking, and they kept clicking from behind. And what did the caption say? Guess who it is. Who are they to do this?”

On top of that, He added, “When this happens, turn around and slap them. Ask them to click their mother or sister like this and show it to you. Disgusting people. They do this all the time at every function. What is this mentality? 90% of the girls that I know and all those who have become mothers now, they never wanted this earlier and don't want this now. I want to see these guys who take these shots. Once I find out who they are...”

Arbaaz Khan was last seen in the 2026 movie Bihu Attack, directed by Suzad Iqbal Khan. Dev Menaria, Daisy Shah, Rahul Dev, Raza Murad, Yukti Kapoor, Hiten Tejwani, Mir Sarwar, Dimpu Baruah and Amiee Misobbah also played prominent roles in the movie.

title: Shah Rukh Khan calls Captain Smit Machchhar saving passengers despite being stabbed a ‘true display of courage’: Not easy to put one’s safety on line
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

After Salman Khan , Shah Rukh Khan has taken to social media to laud the bravery of Indian pilot Captain Smit Machchhar , who helped save the lives of 174 people on board a Flydubai flight after he was attacked and stabbed by his co-pilot mid-air. Shah Rukh lauded Smit for putting the safety of those on board before his own and acting with courage despite his injuries.

Adding to this, Shah Rukh Khan lauded Captain Smit Machchhar. Shah Rukh Khan praises Captain Smit Machchhar Shah Rukh wrote on X (formerly Twitter), “Captain Smit Machchhar, you stood strong when it mattered the most!! It’s not easy to stare adversity in the face and put one’s safety on the line… but you did just that to protect those onboard and showed us what being a Captain entails. A true display of courage and duty. Wishing you a speedy recovery, the country is proud of you…”

Meanwhile, Shah Rukh's praise comes a day after another Bollywood superstar, Salman Khan, lauded Smit's bravery. On Friday night, Salman shared a heartfelt note on X. He wrote, “Kamaal kar diya pilot ji, hum sab aap ko salute karte hain (You’ve done a fantastic job, Pilot-ji; we all salute you) Will be a pleasure to fly with u.. Well done bro.. Capt #SmitMachchhar.”

Notably, Shah Rukh and Salman are not the only Bollywood celebrities who have lauded Captain Smit. Karan Johar of late shared a photo of the captain and wrote, “It takes another grain of courage to be fighting for your own life but in that split second, put the lives of all others before yours. And that's what captain Smit Machchhar did in the face of the toughest times. And for that, the entire country & humankind is behind you! Thank you for your selfless, courageous and brave heart, you are an inspiration for the generations to come.”

As per the latest buzz, Vicky Kaushal called the captain a “braveheart”, while Ranveer Singh described him as “courageous”. Other celebrities, including Paresh Rawal, R Madhavan, Vijay Deverakonda and Ravi Kishan, have also lauded the captain and wished him a speedy recovery.

In further updates, Captain Smit Machchhar was the pilot of Flydubai flight FZ1073, a Boeing 737 MAX 8 travelling from Dubai to Tel Aviv with 174 people on board, including 27 children. On September 30, while the aircraft was flying over Saudi Arabia, Machchhar was attacked and stabbed by his co-pilot inside the cockpit.

On top of that, Despite being seriously injured, Machchhar managed to open the cockpit door. This allowed passengers and crew members to intervene and overpower the attacker. Two other pilots who were travelling on the flight then helped take control of the aircraft, which was diverted and safely landed at Tabuk airport in Saudi Arabia.

Machchhar was taken to hospital following the incident and later spoke to Prime Minister Narendra Modi from his hospital bed. During the conversation, he recounted how he opened the cockpit door despite his injuries, allowing others to help stop the attacker and prevent further danger to those on board.

Meanwhile, The source continued, “As for the Hindi version of Jailer 2 , Pen Marudhar has bought its rights for upwards of Rs. 15 crores. The first Jailer , which was rolled out in 2023, didn’t do much business in Hindi due to competition from Gadar 2 and OMG 2 . Also, it didn’t rollout in national chains. Later, it was widely consumed on OTT and satellite, and hence, the franchise became popular among Hindi-speaking audiences. This time, Jailer 2 is expected to rollout in national chains and therefore has the potential to put up a huge number.”

Notably, The source added, “Rajinikanth’s last movie, Coolie (2025), had a wide rollout across multiplex chains and its Hindi version accumulated Rs. 34 crores in its lifetime, thus proving that Jailer 2 has immense potential in Hindi. title: Police kept close watch for anti-social elements, Maharashtra minister Pankaj Bhoyar on CJP protest
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Maharashtra minister of state for home Pankaj Bhoyar on Saturday shared police kept a close watch on the Cockroach Janata Party’s protest against the Election Commission (EC) in Mumbai on Friday to prevent any anti-social elements from disrupting law and order.

Adding to this, Maharashtra minister Pankaj Bhoyar shared police kept a close watch on the CJP protest in Mumbai to prevent anti-social elements from disrupting law and order. (JANI) More than 10,000 people, predominantly young protesters, including Gen Z participants, gathered at Mumbai’s Shivaji Park on Friday for the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP)-led agitation against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The protest, held despite the police denying permission, was marked by slogans against alleged irregularities in electoral rolls and demands for Kumar’s resignation. The gathering included student groups and prominent personalities such as actors Shabana Azmi and Naseeruddin Shah and singer Vishal Dadlani.

Meanwhile, Bhoyar shared that anti-social elements always try to disrupt peace in the city or the state, but the police administration was maintaining a strict vigil on such elements and their activities.

Notably, “I do not think anybody will try to indulge in such anti-social activities. If anybody is found to be involved in disrupting law and order, the police will thwart such an attempt,” he shared in Nagpur.

As per the latest buzz, Addressing the gathering, CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke shared the Shivaji Park protest was the beginning of a wider agitation and warned of a “Jantar Mantar 2.0” if the CEC did not resign. He shared the movement would be backed by youth and Gen Z and would spread to other cities before culminating in Delhi.

In further updates, Dipke’s demands include the resignation of Kumar, a criminal case against him and the rollback of the SIR exercise, while the Election Commission has defended the revision process and modified it to reduce inconvenience to voters.

On top of that, Meanwhile, Maharashtra Congress too has attacked the BJP government and ECI over alleged irregularities in the electoral system. “The ECI has deleted the names of certain religion from the electoral roll. Not only Gyanesh Kumar, but even PM Narendra Modi and Home minister Amit Shah shoudl resign,” demanded Congress leader Nana Patole.

title: Jantar Mantar protest LIVE: Prashant Bhushan, Yogendra Yadav, AISA's Neha Bora among several detained
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Jantar Mantar protest LIVE: Senior advocate Prashant Bhushan and Swaraj India founder Yogendra Yadav joined the protest on Saturday. Jantar Mantar protest LIVE: The protest against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar at Delhi’s Jantar Mantar continued for the second straight day on Saturday. As Section 163 of the BNSS remained in force in New Delhi, Delhi Police detained several protesters, including advocate Prashant Bhushan, political activist Yogendra Yadav and AISA's Neha Bora. ...Read More

Adding to this, Senior advocates Kapil Sibal and Bhushan had joined Neha Bora in the march towards the protest site. Meanwhile, Indian Youth Congress moved the Delhi High Court against Delhi Police's decision denying them permission to protest at Jantar Mantar against CEC Gyanesh Kumar, Bar and Bench reported. IYC President Uday Bhanu Chib filed a writ petition in the matter. Addressing supporters, Neha Bora shared the protesters would return the next day and asked them to rest and regain their energy before gathering again at Jantar Mantar. “They are using thousands of police personnel to save that one man”, she shared, referring to the security arrangements around the protest and reiterating the demand for Kumar’s resignation. Bora also shared Friday’s mobilisation was not limited to Delhi and that the protest would continue to spread across the country. Meanwhile, political activist Yogendra Yadav also revealed his participation in the next round of protests. In a post on X, he wrote, “Jantar Mantar 2.0 Continues…We meet again today. 3 October” at 1 pm at Jantar Mantar. The protests are centred on allegations of irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and the demand for the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar. Around 1,000 detained across Delhi Around 1,000 people were detained across Delhi on Friday as police and security forces stopped protesters from reaching Jantar Mantar for the proposed demonstration. The protest had been called for 11am by the AAP, AISA, Students’ Federation of India (SFI), National Students’ Union of India (NSUI), Indian Youth Congress (IYC) and other student and youth organisations. Nearly 750 people were detained from areas around Jantar Mantar, while another 400 were detained from other parts of Delhi during the day. Around 200 people were also placed under house arrest in the morning. Those picked up from the streets were taken in buses arranged by the Delhi Police to different police stations. Among those detained were former Delhi chief minister and senior AAP leader Atishi, AISA president Neha Bora and Swaraj India leader Yogendra Yadav. Several other AAP leaders, civil society activists, members of left-backed student organisations and Congress youth wing workers were also detained. More than 5,000 security personnel were deployed in and around Jantar Mantar to prevent protesters from reaching the site.
Meanwhile, “Our Heroes! I hope that when we are your age, we are as strong and steadfast as you all!” Bora shared in a post on X, while sharing photographs from the site of the protest.

Notably, “Modi is an illegal Prime Minister, Shah is an illegal minister, and all the chief ministers who have been elected anywhere are illegal. All of them should be dissolved, elections should be held, and elections should be conducted through ballot papers,” Kharge told reporters, according to PTI news agency.

Notably, Drishyam 3 has emerged as the biggest opener of Ajay Devgn’s career, earning ₹ 66.7 crore rupees in India on Friday, its opening day. The movie has also surpassed Shah Rukh Khan-starrer Pathaan, which had opened at ₹ 57 crore rupees.

As per the latest buzz, The movie has also gone past the opening-day collections of several other major blockbusters, including Ranveer Singh’s Dhurandhar, which collected ₹ 30 crore rupees, and Ranbir Kapoor’s Animal, which opened at ₹ 63 crore rupees. Drishyam 3 as per reports collected ₹ 95 crore rupees worldwide on its opening day. The movie also benefited from the Gandhi Jayanti holiday on Friday.

In further updates, Titled Drishyam: The Conclusion, the movie is the third and final instalment of the Hindi Drishyam franchise. Ajay Devgn returns as Vijay Salgaonkar, with Tabu reprising her role as Meera Deshmukh and Shriya Saran returning as Nandini Salgaonkar. Jaideep Ahlawat joins the cast as a new character.

On top of that, Directed and written by Abhishek Pathak, Drishyam 3 continues Vijay and his family’s story after the events of the first two films. Unlike the first two Hindi instalments, which were remakes of the Malayalam Drishyam films, the third part has a new story and serves as the conclusion to the Hindi franchise.
While speaking at FICCI Frames 2026, Ajay opened up that he called Mohanlal, who has played Georgekutty in the original Malayalam Drishyam films, before going ahead with Drishyam 3.

title: Arjun Das reveals he was in talks for Don 3 before Ranveer Singh-Farhan Akhtar fallout: ‘It's not happening now’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Farhan Akhtar’s Don 3, which was supposed to star Ranveer Singh in the lead role, was among the most anticipated Bollywood films. However, the movie became embroiled in row after Ranveer’s exit from the project and a reported fallout between the star and filmmaker. Amid the uncertainty surrounding the movie, Tamil star Arjun Das has opened up that he was approached by Farhan for Don 3.

Adding to this, Tamil star Arjun Das was approached for Don 3. Arjun Das on being approached for Don 3 In conversation with News18, Arjun Das responded to reports of him being cast in Don 3 and opened up that he had indeed met Farhan Akhtar to discuss the project. “I was very, very fortunate to have received a call from Farhan sir. We did meet, humne discuss bhi kiya tha (we discussed about the part), but unfortunately, that isn’t happening now,” he shared.

Meanwhile, Despite not being able to work with Farhan on Don 3, Arjun shared he hopes to collaborate with the filmmaker in the future. “But I am hoping, and I hope I get to work with Farhan sir soon. I think he is one of the sweetest and most humble people I have met. So, yes, I don’t want to lie about it. It was supposed to happen, but now it’s not happening,” he added. During the same interaction, Arjun also opened up that he will soon be seen in a Hindi project, which is currently in the post-production stage.

Notably, Don 3 was officially revealed in 2023, with Ranveer Singh taking over the iconic role previously played by Amitabh Bachchan and Shah Rukh Khan. However, the movie remained in development for years, with production repeatedly delayed. Reports later suggested that Ranveer had concerns over the script and the lack of a locked screenplay, while there were also claims that the star was unhappy with the delays in taking the movie on floors.

As per the latest buzz, Another point of contention, as per the latest buzz, was the alleged consideration of other actors for the role. Ranveer as per reports claimed that the makers had explored the possibility of approaching Hrithik Roshan while he was still attached to the project and claimed that only after Dhurandhar's success they decided to go ahead with him for the project.

In further updates, Ranveer eventually exited Don 3 in December 2025. Following his exit, Farhan Akhtar and producer Ritesh Sidhwani as per reports sought compensation from the star, which was reported to be around ₹ 45 crore rupees.

On top of that, The disagreement then moved to movie bodies. Farhan and Ritesh approached the Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE), which issued a non-cooperation directive against Ranveer, only to later withdraw it. The makers also took the matter to the Indian Motion Picture Producers’ Association (IMPPA), while Ranveer’s father, Jagjit Singh Bhavnani, met the association and challenged the reported ₹ 45 crore rupees compensation claim on the star’s behalf.
Amid the feud between the star and the director, the status of Don 3 remains uncertain.

title: HT exclusive: Delhi Police register 3 cases over Jantar Mantar protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Delhi Police have registered at least three cases in connection with Friday’s protests by students organisations, political parties and civil society activists whose attempts to gather at Jantar Mantar and demand the resignation of chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls were foiled by police and security forces, at least two senior officers aware of the development shared.

Adding to this, Several protesters were detained during the agitation in Jantar Mantar on Friday. (Vipin Kumar/ Hindustan Times) The three first information reports (FIRs) were registered at two police stations – Parliament Street and Connaught Place – based on daily diary (DD) entries made by police officials. The cases were registered under section 223 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for “disobedience to order duly promulgated by a public servant”, the officers shared.

Meanwhile, “While no individuals or organisations have been named in the suspects/accused’s column of the FIRs, the mentioning of the organisers and organisations that proposed and participated in the demonstrations is in the contents of the FIRs,” one of the officers shared, asking not to be identified.
Notably, It was not immediately known whether more sections of the BNS or other relevant laws were also invoked in the FIRs related to Friday’s demonstrations.

As per the latest buzz, The second officer, who also wished anonymity, shared that the FIRs were registered because, by gathering in large numbers in the New Delhi district and carrying out protests, the protesters violated the prohibitory orders that were already invoked across central Delhi (New Delhi district police jurisdiction) under section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS).

In further updates, Under Section 223 of the BNS, a person found guilty in a court of law may face simple imprisonment for a term of up to six months, a fine of up to ₹ 2,500, or both. The person may face imprisonment up to one year, or a fine that may extend to ₹ 5,000, or both, if he is found guilty of disobedience to a public servant’s order that causes or tends to cause danger to human life, health or safety, or causes or tends to cause a riot or affray,” the second officer cited above shared.

On top of that, To be sure, on Friday morning, nearly three hours before the proposed protests, the Delhi Police posted a message on social media, informing the public that prohibitory orders under Section 163 BNSS had been invoked “to ensure public safety, maintenance of public order and smooth traffic movement.”

Under the 163 BNSS orders, public meetings or assembly of five or more people, processions, demonstrations, picketing or dharnas, shouting of slogans or making of speeches, carrying firearms, banners, placards, lathis, swords, sticks, brickbats, or similar articles are prohibited without prior written permission, the Delhi Police social media post shared.

title: Komal Rani Swarnkar defends wearing sindoor in outing with Govinda, reacts to criticism: ‘Man-eaters who destroy their husband's dignity’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Govinda's rumoured girlfriend Komal Rani Swarnkar has reacted to the criticism over her wearing sindoor during her recent visit to Lalbaugcha Raja with the star.

Adding to this, Komal Rani Swarnkar opens up about her visit to Lalbaugcha Raja with Govinda. 'Since when did going out with my hero become a matter of shame' Komal's note called out celebrities for allegedly maligning her and Govinda's names and speaking openly about them on social media while staying silent on important political and social issues. She defended her visit to Lalbaugcha Raja with Govinda, saying it was to seek blessings for their soon-to-release movie, Roopa.

Meanwhile, She wrote, "Since when did going before Ganpati Bappa alongside my Hero and praying for the success of my soon-to-release Movie, Roopa, become a matter of shame, a national issue or "Dikhawa" for others? And when these very so -called celebrities visit various public places with their own male co- stars to promote their Films. Don't they feel ashamed when they do exactly the same thing themselves?"

Notably, Komal took a swipe at those commenting on her and Govinda's relationship, accusing them of using the row to stay relevant. She wrote, “Some actresses in the movie industry, whose careers have gone cold, whose films are no longer working at the ticket-window, seem to have nothing left except their washed- out brand tags. They are trying to stay relevant by sticking their noses into other people's ongoing controversies and trying desperately to keep themselves in the limelight.”

As per the latest buzz, Calling out the sindoor jibe, Komal wrote, “I have no interest in taking lessons on sindoor, marriage, or our Indian culture and traditions from women who themselves mock sindoor, whose own marriages are falling apart, and who cannot even uphold the sanctity of their own marital relationships.”

In further updates, Komal also took indirect digs at her critics in her Instagram post, making references to alcoholism and infidelity without naming anyone. She wrote, "I do not consider such women worthy of judging me-especially those who idolise and support people who have spent their lives drinking all night, indulging in multiple affairs with other men, and even fantasising about one-night stands with three three men in their old age, while publicly humiliating for their own fame to the very husbands they lived with and benefited from throughout their lives. I honestly don't give a damn whether these people thinnk that I am a good person or a bad one."

On top of that, Komal ended her note by asking the women to stop seeking relevance through her name. She wrote, “I feel they are all part of the same group, taking out their frustration over their own failed marriages on someone else. They behave like man-eaters-women who destroy their husbands' dignity and reputation. Stop trying to stay relevant by constantly associating yourselves with my name. Perhaps the saying is true: your dignity is in your own hands. People like that should know their limits and stop provoking others to the point where your own past may be exposed.”

Govinda and Komal visited Lalbaugcha Raja on the same day that Sunita Ahuja visited the pandal alone. This raised eyebrows amid Govinda alleged affair with Komal. However, Govinda has repeatedly denied the allegations and maintained that his appearances with Komal are connected to their professional association and their soon-to-release movie, Roopa.

title: Maatrubhumi release cleared? Salman Khan war drama gets government nod after changes show China 'in a positive light': Report
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

It has been an unusual journey for Salman Khan ’s war drama Maatrubhumi . The movie has seen a title change, reactions to the teaser, multiple postponements, and lately, an uncertainty about whether it will ever be rolled out. But a new report claims that that is all in the past now, and Maatrubhumi could be hitting the screens as early as next month.

Adding to this, Salman Khan in a still from Maatrubhumi. Maatrubhumi gets government NOC: Report It had been reported that Maatrubhumi, which was initially about the clash between Indian and Chinese forces at Galwan , was either shelved or delayed because the Centre was unsure how it would portray the Chinese. Now, Bollywood Hungama has cited a source as saying that the I&B Ministry is now ‘satisfied’ with the new version of the movie and gave it an NOC last week. Maatrubhumi as per reports underwent a series of reshoots after the Defence Ministry objected to its early anti-China stance. The report quoted the source as saying: “The new version of Maatrubhumi is highly altered compared to the original version. Moreover, it now also talks about the relationship between India and China in a positive light.”

Meanwhile, While the makers of Maatrubhumi have not verified this development yet, the Bollywood Hungama report even says that Salman Khan has a rollout date in mind. It mentions the source as saying, “Salman Khan is now eyeing November 13. He believes that the post-Diwali period, when people would still be in a celebratory mood, would be apt for the movie’s rollout. However, the censor process is still pending. The makers will soon submit the movie to the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC). If the CBFC clears the movie and the process is completed this month, Salman and his team will most probably bring Maatrubhumi to cinemas on November 13. A clearer picture in this regard will emerge in the next 10 days.”
Notably, If this holds true, Maatrubhumi may rollout in theatres a week after Nitesh Tiwari’s big-budget spectacle, Ramayana Part One.

title: ‘They were not granted permission’: Shivaji Park resident files complaint over CJP protest in Mumbai
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
A complaint was filed with the Mumbai Police on Friday against the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders for their protest at Shivaji Park against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

Adding to this, Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijit Dipke, along with Chief Spokesperson Saurav Das, National Spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka and Singer Vishal Dadlani, during a protest seeking Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over voter roll deletions at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Park, Dadar, in Mumbai on Friday. (ANI) The complainant, identified by the news agency ANI as advocate Siddhi Deolekar, who shared she has been a resident of Shivaji Park for the last 10 years, shared that while she was not against the right to protest, there were “designated sites” for doing so. She cited the Bombay high court order that the Mumbai Police had referred to when denying permission for the protest.

Meanwhile, She told the news agency: “I have lodged a complaint against the CJP founders for conducting an illegal protest today. They were not granted permission, and this is the letter issued by the Shivaji Park Police Station to Ajinkya Shinde…. Despite the order of the Bombay high court, they decided to conduct the protest on the roads today. Well, I am not against protests. Everyone has the right to protest, but there are designated places for protests. So why come onto the road and protest like this?”
Notably, The complainant shared that the protesters can go to Azad Maidan or Jantar Mantar for the stir.

As per the latest buzz, "Why block the roads and traffic and sit outside other people’s houses to protest? What kind of protest is this? If you want the Election Commissioner to resign, then go and protest at Jantar Mantar, but not opposite our houses,” she added.
In further updates, Deolekar thanked the Mumbai police for the assurance given to her, saying that she and others with her “simply needed assistance and wanted to feel secure”.

On top of that, “I really want to thank the Mumbai Police. They assured us—not just me, but many other citizens like me who went and complained. We simply needed assistance and wanted to feel secure. There were many people like me who approached the police, and we were assisted very well...I hope appropriate action will be taken against them," she added.

CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke revealed the Mumbai protest as the first leg of a nationwide agitation, alleging irregularities in electoral rolls and demanding greater accountability in the Election Commission's functioning.

body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

The third part of the Drishyam franchise rolled out in theatres on Friday to almost universally positive reviews and audience reactions. Adding to this, Drishyam 3 worldwide ticket-window earnings day 1: Ajay Devgn as Vijay Salgaonkar in a still from Drishyam The Conclusion. Drishyam 3 ticket-window update The advance bookings for Drishyam The Conclusion opened on September 27, five days before the movie hits the screens. The movie registered the fourth-highest advance-booking collection for an opening day by a Hindi movie. The overall advance booking for the movie by rollout day exceeded ₹ 50 crore rupees. This converted into a strong opening day. In India, Drishyam The Conclusion collected a staggering ₹ 66.75 crore rupees net ( ₹ 80.10 crore rupees gross) on its opening day.
